projecthero.guide.symbiote.black_suit.bo: Sneak + Web Yank's key -- Symbiote Tendril Strike, a short-range tendril hit for real damage and a knockback. Sneak + Web Shot's key, held -- Symbiote Crush, locking a target within 10 blocks and crushing it for 8 damage a second for up to 5 seconds. Sneak + the wall-crawl toggle's key -- Symbiote Slam, driving you into the ground for a 15-damage shockwave when airborne, an ordinary slam when grounded. All are paced by their own cooldowns, shown in the HUD next to the usual six web-ability boxes.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.symbiote_te: A short-range tendril lash for real damage and a solid knockback -- the same hit the Normal host's Tendril Strike lands, not a pull.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.symbiote_cr: Look at a target within 10 blocks and hold to crush it in the symbiote -- 8 damage a second for up to 5 seconds, black particles covering it the whole time. Release to let go.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.symbiote_sl: Airborne, it drives you straight down into the ground for a 15-damage black-symbiote shockwave on impact. On the ground it is just an ordinary slam where you stand.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.spider_passiv: Symbiote Spider-Man keeps his own kit: the black suit (extra armour), the extra abilities above, a double-size web reserve and stronger swings and Spider-Sense. The base host's Biomass bar, Regeneration, Resistance, camouflage, Predator Vision and tool-claws are not part of it.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.bioma: Biomass -- the Symbiote's own 200-point life bar, shown under the ability boxes as a percentage and a thin bar. Every hit still lands on you in full, but the Symbiote also loses 40% of that damage from its Biomass. Out of combat for 5 seconds it repairs itself (more slowly while the suit is on, and not at all while the Blade or Shield is feeding on it). Dying no longer refills it: you come back with the Biomass you had. At zero Biomass every Symbiote ability locks until it has recovered.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.recov: Symbiote Recovery -- Regeneration II whenever you are not at full health, paid for with a little of the Symbiote's Biomass (about 2 per second of healing). It does nothing while you are at full health.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.bare_: Living Claws -- your empty hand mines and harvests like a wooden pickaxe, axe and shovel all at once.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.weakness.soni: Sound attacks -- a Warden's boom, a bell, a goat horn -- tear the suit off you and disable every Symbiote ability for 5 seconds, and the Symbiote reacts out loud. Sonic damage also hurts 50% more while suited.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.weakness.fire: Fire and lava hurt 50% more while suited. Stay on fire for more than 2 seconds and the suit deactivates -- it retracts and cannot be called back for 10 seconds (it will not re-wrap you on its own while you burn). The bond itself is never lost.
projecthero.guide.symbiote_spider_man.bo: A Symbiote that bonded with an existing Spider-Man: the living black suit over the web-slinger's own gear. Every web ability stays on its usual keys -- the Symbiote layers three sneak-modified extras on top instead of asking for new ones.
projecthero.guide.symbiote_spider_man.pa: +30% melee damage on top of Spider-Man's own strength.
Web Reserve capacity doubled -- a permanent perk of the bond, kept even with the suit retracted.
Symbiote Recovery -- noticeably faster natural regeneration than an ordinary player.

projecthero.guide.green_lantern.body: A bonded Power Ring channels willpower into Ring Charge — a reserve shown as a percentage that fuels flight, ranged bolts, shields and hard-light constructs shaped on the fly. A permanent, passive Resistance I comes with the bond itself, suited or not. Green Lantern is the mod's toolbox hero: exceptionally versatile, but never the single strongest tank, striker or speedster. The Ring Charge pool and construct upkeep are the balancing axis — strong offense, defence and utility at once drains it fast.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.step.fin: Find a Fallen Lantern Site — a rare, damaged crater holding a Dormant Power Ring pedestal.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.step.tri: Requires experience level 20 or higher. Right-click the pedestal to begin the Will Trial: three waves of enemies within 32 blocks — glowing green, immune to daylight burning. A shimmer of green particles marks the edge of the trial; everyone and everything but you and the trial's own mobs is pushed straight back out, and re-expelled if they wander in again. Leaving the radius for 8s, dying or logging out fails it (10-minute cooldown to retry). Win, and the ring asks only: 'Are you afraid?' Answer NO to earn the ring — the pedestal breaks for good and the ring and its Power Battery core are yours. Answer YES and the trial is cancelled with nothing gained, the site immediately open to anyone (you included) again. Right-click the ring to put it on: it bonds and the item is used up — and it makes you Green Lantern in place of whatever other Primary power you had (a bonded Symbiote is removed too).
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.charge.b: 0-10,000, with no passive regeneration at all — the only way to recharge is a Personal Power Battery. The last 250 points are an emergency reserve, spendable only on an emergency flight descent — never on attacks or constructs. You take no fall damage at all as long as the ring has any charge left.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.flight.b: Double-tap Space while airborne to take off, or land to end it automatically — the same gesture Thor and Iron Man use for their own flight. Costs a flat 1 charge/sec while flying, at the same cruising speed and pose as the Flight power, with a trailing green hard-light streak the whole time. Sprint-hold to Boost for noticeably more speed at 40 charge/sec plus a thicker trail. Ends safely on depletion with a brief controlled descent instead of a plummet.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.air_tank: No key press needed. Swim below half your air supply and the ring builds a small hard-light rebreather on your own body — a tank on your back, a mask under your chin, pipes connecting them — that keeps your air topped up for as long as you're underwater and can afford 1 charge/sec. Shuts off the instant you surface or the ring can't cover it.
A fast hard-light bolt (13 damage, 40-block range, 10 charge), fired from the ring hand rather than the eyes. Shift channels a beam for 4 damage every half-second (8 DPS) while held, draining 10 charge/sec, at the cost of 20% movement speed.
Construct Fist / Shift: War Hammer Slam

A hard-light fist strikes for 16 damage with strong knockback (2s cooldown, 30 charge). Shift slams a hard-light hammer into the ground for 17 damage in a 10-block-radius knock-up (5s cooldown, 40 charge).

Hold to recite the Oath (release early and it's cancelled, no cost). Finish it and you're empowered for 22 seconds: double ability damage, double melee, double construct strength — at double the Ring Charge cost for everything, plus a flat 10 charge/sec just to sustain it. A green aura surrounds you the whole time; the X key shows the seconds remaining. An 80-second cooldown follows once it ends.

A green hard-light riot shield that floats a block in front of you (visible to you as well as everyone else) and tracks your aim while held, absorbing incoming damage into its own HP. Shift expands a 10-block dome out from you over a second and a half instead, pushing out anyone nearby who isn't in your squad and keeping them out for as long as it's up — Shift again dismisses it early (8-second cooldown). Both share one uptime meter, shown above your ability keys while it's draining or refilling: up to 22 seconds of continuous use before it forces itself off, recharging on its own once you stop.

Forms or retracts the hard-light suit in a rising (or falling) ring of green light — full diamond-level protection (20 armour, 2.0 toughness) plus a flat +8 melee damage bonus while worn. Costs 10 charge to summon, plus 1 charge every 5 seconds while worn — running out of charge forces it to retract. Shift casts Ring Scan: every living creature within 50 blocks glows through walls for 6 seconds, red for hostiles and green for everything else — visible only to you, on a 5-second cooldown.
Deploy Construct / hold: construct wheel / Shift: dismiss all

Tap to shape the selected construct. Hold for half a second to open the construct wheel and pick a different one instead of deploying. Shift dismisses every active construct. Deploy and upkeep costs are low across the board, and there's no limit on how many can be active at once (Sentry Turret alone caps at 5 live, 12 seconds each). A construct still on cooldown from its last use is shown, with a countdown, just above your ability keys.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.construc: Temporary hard-light shapes, not free building blocks — each costs charge up front plus ongoing upkeep. No cap on how many can be active at once any more (Sentry Turret is the one exception, capped at 5 live, 12 seconds each). Every construct is available the moment you bond, no unlock requirement. Battering Ram is an instant dash-and-bash rather than a standing construct. Rescue Tether is a proper grab (30-block range): press the construct key on whatever's under your crosshair to pick it up and carry it in front of you, press again to throw it, or Shift the construct key to set it down safely with no fall damage — holding one costs charge every second. Containment Cage traps whatever's under your crosshair — any living target, not just hostiles — in a hollow shell that also seals its floor or ceiling wherever there's open space to slip through, and collapses on its own after 15 seconds. Carry Platform is a 3x3 hard-light platform spawned level with you, chasing your aim briskly whenever it's toggled to drive; press the construct key again to toggle whether it's actively driving toward your aim (5 blocks out) or just parked, and anyone can right-click a tile to ride along. Mining Drill and Energy Blade deploy for free as an equipped stance — a second press of the construct key toggles the drill or blade itself on (only then does it cost anything), and a third turns it back off. The Mining Drill breaks a 2x2 patch of blocks every 0.5 seconds while it is switched on.
Craft one (Lantern Core + 4 Emerald Blocks + 2 Amethyst Blocks + an Ender Eye + an Echo Shard) and right-click it below max charge to recite the Oath — four lines appear on screen, one at a time, in green. Finish the recitation and your ring fills instantly; any movement, turning, damage or ability use cancels it with nothing gained. This is now the only way to recharge — the ring no longer regenerates charge on its own.

projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.preda: Predator Vision -- while bonded you see every living thing within 20 blocks outlined: hostile mobs red, other players dark purple, everything else dark blue. Only YOU see it -- nobody else's view changes. Press N (Utility 2) to switch it off and on.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.resur: Resurrection -- the Symbiote will not let its host die. hud.projecthero.wolverine.title: WOLVERINE
projecthero.guide.wolverine.tier: Primary Power - Ascension of Super Regeneration
projecthero.guide.wolverine.body: Your regenerative mutation, taken all the way: a healing factor that shrugs off almost anything, a stronger and faster body, and retractable adamantium claws. It is a fighter's power -- close range, brutal, and very hard to put down.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.step.prereq: 1. Own Super Regeneration (power 12). Wolverine cannot be obtained without it.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.step.serum: 2. Craft an Adamantium Serum (4 diamonds, 2 netherite ingots, 2 blaze powder, a golden apple) and use it. It consumes Super Regeneration and replaces your mutations, like any Primary power. Admins: /wolverine power grant.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.claws.body: Three curved blades in each hand, hidden until you want them. H deploys or retracts them (Shift+H still opens the power wheel if you also own mutations). While they are out they break blocks like a sword (cobwebs give way at once, plants and leaves 1.5x faster) and your bare-hand attack is 12 damage (4 with claws away, +8 unarmed with them out) and you mine 1.5x faster. You cannot hold items in either hand while the claws are out (they are stowed in your inventory). Left-click slashes with a random claw -- left hand or right -- for the same damage either way. Hold right-click to block: both sets of claws cross in front of you and anything a shield could stop does 30% less damage (falls, fire, drowning and magic still get through), but -- like a raised shield -- you can't attack while guarding. Deploying the claws tears through your hands for 4 damage (never enough to kill you) -- but that is not a fight: it never fills your Rage bar and never tears your suit. Every claw move deploys them for you if they are away. Other players see your claws.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.suit.body: A craftable yellow-and-blue suit (Cowl, Suit, Leggings, Boots) made from leather and yellow / blue dye, found in the Superheroes tab, with leather-level protection. It gets visibly torn and bloodied as your health drops (and stays torn, repairing itself over 20 seconds once you recover), with big chunks breaking away to bare your skin, and is almost torn off during the Death Surge. Chainmail-level protection, diamond-level durability. Anyone can wear it.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.death.body: If a Wolverine dies, his body gives way to raw flesh and bone for the death animation, visible to everyone.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.sniff: Sniff: highlight every living thing within 40 blocks for 20 seconds. No cooldown; your own screen only.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.lmb: Claws out: slash with a random hand, left or right
projecthero.guide.wolverine.rmb: Claws out: hold to block -- 30% less damage, no attacking
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.claw: A fast forward slash for 18 damage to everything in a box 3.5 blocks deep and 3 blocks wide in front of you. 1.5-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.cros: Two crossing cuts, 12 + 12 damage, to everything in a box 3 blocks deep and 3 blocks wide in front of you. 4-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.claw: Launch yourself 21 blocks along your aim, leaning into the lunge with both claws thrust forward. You cannot dash through blocks and you are knockback-immune mid-dash. Every enemy in a 3-block-wide path takes 12 damage (once each), and the first one you hit -- mob or player -- is grabbed and dragged along in front of you until you land. Your claw moves swing left and right hands in turn. 6-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.bers: Needs a full rage meter (it fills the C box on your HUD): every hit you land or take fills 1% of it, whatever the damage, and it drains 5% per second once you have gone 10 seconds without a fight. Then 30 seconds of fury: +50% damage, +30% speed, 20% extra damage reduction and near-total knockback immunity. The meter empties when it starts; no cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.fren: Five rapid strikes, 8 damage each (0.2 s apart), spread over the nearest enemies within 4 blocks. Needs a target. 15-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.adam: Hold the key for 5 seconds to charge (you move slowly while charging), then release: whatever you're looking at within 10 blocks glows red for you and Wolverine launches straight at them for a 60-damage claw strike with heavy knockback. A whiff only costs 8 seconds. 30-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.toggle: Claw toggle: deploy / retract the claws
projecthero.guide.wolverine.passives.bod: Healing factor: 1.5 HP every 5 ticks (6 HP/s), but every HP it heals is paid from a Healing Factor pool of 250 HP (the green bar on your HUD, with its percentage). At 0 the healing factor is OFF until the pool has some charge again. The pool only refills once you have gone 5 seconds without TAKING damage, then 5 HP per second. 35% less physical damage, 75% knockback resistance, 75% less fall damage. Strong Poison and Wither resistance. melee damage of 4 (12 unarmed with the claws out), jump 2 blocks high (no passive speed bonus). Any mob hunting you glows orange, for you alone (enhanced senses). Fire still hurts, but you outheal it while the pool lasts. Lethal falls: a fall that would kill you leaves you at half a heart instead. The Healing Factor pool takes the damage (at most 100 -- anything beyond is not taken), your legs turn to raw flesh and you are slowed (Slowness VI) for 20 seconds, then your skin phases back in over the flesh across another 20 seconds. It needs some pool left: with the healing factor spent, a lethal fall still kills.
message.projecthero.wolverine.hands_full: No room to stow your items -- the claws retract.
message.projecthero.wolverine.claws_no_i: You cannot hold items with the claws out.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.emergency.bo: A lethal hit does not kill you: you burst in a spray of blood and rise at 30% health as a raw flesh-and-bone body. For 20 seconds you are slowed (Slowness III), blinded and weakened and a red shadow closes in on your screen; for the first 5 of those you cannot take any damage. Then the debuffs lift and your skin slowly grows back over the flesh for another 20 seconds. It recharges for 3 minutes; while it is recharging you can die. /kill and the void always work. A 3-pixel marker to the left of the Healing Factor bar shows it: ORANGE when it is charged, dark grey (like an empty bar) while it recharges.

Press H to transform (a full Titan Energy bar -- or hold H for 5 s with at least 30% for a weaker, pale Emergency Titan). Inside the Titan: R Punch (Shift+R Kick), G Heavy Smash, Z Stomp, X Leap (Shift+X Roar), V Roar, C Regeneration (Shift+C Hardening), N grab / eat a mob (Shift+N set it down), hold Sprint 3 s to run.

hud.projecthero.titan_shifter.title: Titan Shifter
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.tier: Hero Tier -- a Primary power (you can hold two).
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.body: Drink a Titan Serum and you gain the power to burst into an 11-block giant -- a regular player-shaped body scaled up, and a real creature with its own 500 HP, heavy armour and a huge body that everyone in the world sees and can fight. You steer it from inside; while you are a Titan you cannot be hurt directly, the Titan takes the hits. When it falls (or you step out) you are yourself again.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.step.ser: Craft a Titan Serum (4 Titanium-Gold Plates in the corners, 2 Netherite Ingots above and below, 2 Magma Blocks left and right, a Golden Apple in the middle) and use it. It only UNLOCKS the power -- it does not transform you. Any other Primary power beyond your two slots is replaced, oldest first.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.transfor: Press H on open ground with a FULL Titan Energy bar (the Titan needs room -- leaves and plants in the way are blown aside, solid blocks are not). With less than a full bar and under 30%, "Titan Form exhausted, Recharge energy" flashes in red above your hotbar; between 30% and 100% you can HOLD H for an Emergency Titan instead (see below). Lightning flashes without harm, bystanders are shoved back, and for about 3 seconds you are helpless while the Titan swells up around you. Press H again to change back: you climb out through the back of the Titan's neck and drift down, while its body slumps where it stood, steams every 3 seconds and dissolves over one minute, breaking apart piece by piece -- each piece shrinking away to nothing before it goes. Shift+H still opens the power wheel while you are human. There is no lockout after reverting -- the Titan Energy bar is the limit. Squad-mates can right-click the Titan to ride its shoulders (two seats, sneak to hop off). Hold Sprint while walking for 3 seconds and the Titan breaks into a run. Press N to grab the mob you are looking at, N again to EAT it (26 damage, 10 s recharge; it fills your hunger and saturation and the Titan heals 5 HP per second for 5 seconds), Shift+N to set it gently down.
R: a heavy swing: 20 damage and strong knockback, 0.8 s recharge. The punch goes where you AIM: look up at something on a ledge or in the air, straight ahead at something level with the Titan's head, or down at the ground -- anything right in front of the Titan is still hit too. The third swing of a combo is a Heavy Punch (35, a little more reach). Hold Shift while pressing it for a Titan Kick (30, a wide low sweep).

G: the Titan raises both fists (slowed while it charges), then brings them down: 50 damage in a small area with huge knockback and a shockwave. It lands where you AIM -- on the mob or block under your crosshair up to about 12 blocks past the Titan, even up on a ledge or in the air; aim at nothing and it hits the ground just ahead (or, looking up, the air in front of you). 8 s recharge.
Z: lifts a foot and stamps: 25 damage and knockback to everything within 6 blocks, dust and a tremor. 6 s recharge.

X: a crouch, then a huge jump (about three times a normal jump, about 20 blocks forward). Leap while SPRINTING (or running) and you launch roughly twice as far. Landing hits everything within 5 blocks for 20. 5 s recharge. Shift+X is the Titan Roar.

V (or Shift+X): a deafening roar that reaches everything within 32 blocks -- ground level and up -- and hits it with Weakness II and Slowness III for 12 s, Nausea for 3 s, Blindness for 2 s and Mining Fatigue for 3 s. Weaker mobs are thrown back and flee. Bosses only take a quarter of the effect and are not knocked back. 15 s recharge. v0.12.43: the roar also outlines everything within 50 blocks of the Titan in BLUE for 10 seconds -- on your screen only, nobody else sees it.
C: the Titan heals 10 HP per second for 10 seconds on top of its base regeneration (steam pours off it). 45 s recharge. Useless at full health.
Shift+C: the skin crystallises for 8 seconds -- 60% less damage and the Titan looks like hardened crystal. 30 s recharge.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.stats.bo: 500 HP, 25 armour, 8 armour toughness, no knockback, 11 blocks tall and about 3.7 wide (a regular player's hit-box, scaled up). It takes no fall damage at all, a fifth of fire damage and half of explosions, and shrugs off tiny hits from players -- but ordinary mobs ignore its armour and hurt it normally, and mobs hunting you will attack the Titan. Its steps shake the ground and the camera of everyone nearby; it tramples leaves and plants but never digs through solid terrain (a server option allows its attacks to break weak blocks).
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.defeat.b: At 0 HP the Titan collapses in a cloud of steam and you drop out on your own feet -- slowed and weakened for 5 seconds while you recover, and your Titan Energy is empty, so you must recharge it (1% a second) before shifting again. Your own health is whatever it was before. Logging out inside the Titan puts you back on the ground as a human; the Titan itself never persists or duplicates.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.commands: /projecthero power grant titan_shifter [player]  (op level 2). Every number above is in config/projecthero_titan_shifter.json.
projecthero.guide.thor.perks.body: Being bound to Mjolnir gives you, permanently and whether or not the hammer is in your hand: +11 melee damage bare-handed, +10 hearts, +18% speed, some knockback resistance, 80% less damage from every source (falls and lightning cannot hurt you at all) and Regeneration I at all times. Mjolnir itself hits for 11 swung, 18 thrown. Your ability bar stays on screen for as long as you are bound to a hammer, even when Mjolnir is not in your hands.
projecthero.guide.thor.armour.body: Press H while bound to Mjolnir: lightning strikes down on you and Thor's Armour forms on your body -- a black-and-crimson chestplate, leggings and boots (anything you were wearing in those slots goes into your inventory). Press H again to dismiss it. The armour is conjured, not crafted, so it can never leave you: if it falls out of your inventory or you die, it simply despawns. Shift+H still opens the power wheel.
item.projecthero.thor_armor_chestplate.d: Conjured by pressing H while bound to Mjolnir. Vanishes if it leaves your inventory or you die.

Titan Form Exhausted -- still drained from the last Emergency Titan -- recharge to 100% first.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.should: You climb onto the Titan's shoulder. Sneak to hop off.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.nothin: No mob in reach to grab -- look at one.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.energy.b: A 100-point bar (a yellow bar with a percentage on your HUD). Changing back -- or being defeated or forced out -- empties it, and it then refills 1% every second while you are human; Titan Shift Ready appears at 100%. Your base (human) form heals itself with Regeneration II, but that costs energy: while you are hurt it drains 1.5% a second and the bar does not refill, and at 0% the healing stops. The Titan itself has no passive regeneration -- only the C ability heals it. Press Shift+N (or plain N if no other power of yours uses N) in your human form to switch the passive Regeneration II off or on -- off means no healing and no energy drain; a note under the bar reminds you.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.emergenc: Below a full bar you are not stuck: with at least 30% Titan Energy, press and HOLD H for 5 seconds (electricity crackles around you and a countdown shows above your hotbar; let go and it is cancelled). You then shift into an Emergency Titan -- PALE, only 7 blocks tall and 40% weaker in everything (health, armour, speed and the damage of every hit). You can stay in it for at most 2 minutes: a thin pale bar above the Titan Shifter text slowly drains, and when it empties you are forced out (H changes back earlier, as usual). Afterwards you are exhausted ("Titan Form Exhausted" shows on your HUD until you are back at 100%): Titan Energy refills 3 times slower and you get no passive regeneration until you are back at 50%, and you cannot shift again -- normally or in an emergency -- until the bar is back at 100%.
item.projecthero.one_for_all_vestige.des: A stockpile of power handed down through generations. Use it to become All Might.
Grants the One For All power. H transforms, R/G/X/Z/V/C are the Smashes, N leaps.

message.projecthero.all_might.acquired_h: H switches to your Power Form. In it: R Detroit (Shift+R New Hampshire), G Texas, X Leap, Z United States of Smash (hold), V Carolina, C Plus Ultra, N the costume locker.
message.projecthero.all_might.armour_tor: Your armour tears off your body as you swell!
message.projecthero.all_might.armour_ref: The Power Form cannot wear %s -- only the All Might armour.

hud.projecthero.all_might.title: One For All
projecthero.guide.all_might.tier: Hero Tier -- a Primary power (you can hold two).
projecthero.guide.all_might.body: The strongest pure-strength hero in the pack. In his Base Form he is simply a regular player; press H and he swells to 2.7 blocks tall over a second, venting steam, into his Power Form: enormous punches that move air, shockwaves that flatten crowds, leaps that clear buildings and one ultimate Smash that levels a battlefield. His blue-and-white costume is craftable armour: leave it in the costume locker (N) and it goes on by itself every time you transform.
projecthero.guide.all_might.step.vestige: Craft a Vestige of One For All (4 Titanium-Gold Plates in the corners, 2 Enchanted Golden Apples above and below, 2 Diamond Blocks left and right, a Totem of Undying in the middle) and use it. Like every Primary power it replaces your oldest one if both slots are full. Admins: /projecthero power grant all_might.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ofa.body: A 300-point reserve shown as a TIMER on the HUD (300 = 5:00) beside the "One For All" title. Simply BEING in the Power Form drains it 1 point every second, so a full bar is 5 minutes of Power Form -- when it hits 0:00 you drop back to your Base Form (and cannot re-enter until you have 1 point). Only the Base Form refills it: 1 point every 2 seconds. The Smashes and the Leap cost nothing; only Plus Ultra (50) and the United States of Smash (100, paid when the punch is actually cast) spend a one-off amount, and you cannot use them without it. Below 30 you start venting steam.
projecthero.guide.all_might.forms.body: Base Form (default): a regular Minecraft player -- no abilities, no bonuses, no costume, and the only form in which One For All refills. Power Form (press H, again to change back): 13 melee damage and a 6-block hit range, 40 max HP (your health percentage carries over: 50% in one form is 50% in the other), 50% less damage from everything, NO fall damage, Speed III, slow self-healing (1 HP every 4 seconds), a 3-block jump and a 2.7-block body -- and it drains One For All 1 a second. Changing takes 1 second, during which you cannot be hurt, and steam pours off you both ways. Transforming shows "I am HERE"; changing back shows nothing. The Power Form can only wear the All Might armour: if you transform while wearing regular armour it tears off your body (each piece takes 50 durability damage, and is destroyed if that is more than it has left), unequips itself and drops on the ground; regular armour equipped afterwards is bounced back to your inventory. The Power Form's particles are gold.
projecthero.guide.all_might.costume.body: Nobody starts with it. Craft All Might's Costume (blue, white and yellow wool) and All Might's Trousers (blue and red wool). In the Power Form press N to open the costume locker -- two slots, one for the costume and one for the trousers -- and put the pieces in: from then on they are put on automatically whenever you transform and go back into the locker when you change back (closing the locker in the Power Form wears them at once). Your own head and hat layer stay visible -- the costume has no helmet. The locker keeps its contents through death.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.tran: H: switch between the Base Form and the Power Form. Persistent until you press H again.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.detr: R: a devastating close-range punch -- 18 damage, and the punch's air pressure carries 10 blocks forward (3.5 wide) so you can hit enemies without touching them, huge knockback, breaks a few weak blocks. Free, 3 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.texa: G: a wide travelling air blast -- 24 damage to everything in an 18-block-long wave that starts 4 blocks wide and widens to 10, very strong knockback. Free, 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.caro: V: a high-speed slide about 15 blocks along the ground, following wherever you're looking for the whole slide (not just the direction you started facing), hitting everything in your path for 20 with strong knockback and leaving a wind trail. It stops at walls. Free, 5 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.new_: Shift+R: launch 15 blocks up and forward, firing an air-pressure blast 20 blocks long, 6 wide and 8 tall (built for flyers and giants), striking whatever you fly through for 20, then crash down in a 6-block shockwave. Works from the air too. Free, 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.unit: Z: the ultimate. HOLD Z for 5 seconds (a growing aura and building wind, with a thin charge bar under your ability keys; let go early and it is simply cancelled -- nothing is spent and no cooldown starts), then a gigantic punch that is an AoE: a 75-damage air blast tears 25 blocks straight ahead, then a shockwave bursts out from you in every direction to 35 blocks, with extreme knockback and a large crater. Bosses only take a fraction of their health per hit. 100 One For All and a 75 s cooldown, both only once it has been cast.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.all_: X: a huge leap launched in the direction you are looking (always with some lift), and a landing shockwave. Cannot hurt you. Free, 1.5 s cooldown -- no cooldown at all while Plus Ultra is active.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.plus: C: Plus Ultra. Costs 50 One For All once, then lasts exactly 22 seconds (the seconds left show in the C box): every one of your moves hits 30% harder. It cannot be switched off early; a 20 s cooldown starts when it ends (or if you change back to your Base Form).
projecthero.guide.all_might.passives.bod: In the Power Form you take no fall damage at all, ordinary punches knock enemies back with an air burst, and hard landings from a real fall release a shockwave: a small one (2 damage, 2 blocks), a medium one (8, 4 blocks) or a heavy one (20, 7 blocks). Bosses are never knocked back and lose at most 10% of their health to a single Smash. Block destruction (weak blocks only, never bedrock) can be switched off in AllMightConfig. The Base Form has none of this.
projecthero.guide.all_might.commands.bod: /projecthero power grant all_might [player]  (op level 2). Every number above lives in AllMightConfig.

projecthero.agent_venom.ability.suit.des: A bonded Punisher presses H and the Symbiote wraps him in the Agent Venom suit (H again retracts it). Diamond-plus protection, +25% melee, +15% speed and jump, +25% knockback resistance, and the whole Punisher kit still works.
projecthero.agent_venom.ability.agent_ve: Sneak + X: a tendril snaps onto the block you are aiming at (up to 36 blocks) and hauls you to it. No fall damage for 3 seconds after. 3 s cooldown.

Sneak + Z: lash the mob you are aiming at (18 blocks) for 5 damage, drag it to you bound in tendrils (Slowness III), and rip whatever it is holding out of its hand. Bosses are held but not dragged or disarmed. 8 s cooldown.
Sneak + V: let the Symbiote off the leash for 10 seconds -- +50% melee, +20% speed, and every punch heals you for 30% of the damage it deals. 45 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.agent_venom.body: The Symbiote no longer purges the Punisher. Bond with one as the Punisher (or become the Punisher while bonded) and you are Agent Venom: press H to let the suit take hold, H again to retract it. You keep every Punisher ability; the suit adds three Symbiote extras on Sneak + your existing keys, shown in their own three boxes left of the Punisher HUD.
projecthero.guide.agent_venom.passives.b: Symbiote Rounds: +20% firearm damage, and every bullet that lands lashes the target with tendrils (a moment of Slowness). Living Ammunition: the suit feeds your guns -- the reserve regenerates three times as fast and reloads are 25% quicker. The Symbiote is still a Symbiote: fire, lava and loud sounds (explosions, bells, the Warden) drive it off, and it wraps you on its own when you are badly hurt.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.host.agent_ve: A player who holds the Punisher becomes Agent Venom -- the Agent Venom suit on top of the whole Punisher kit, with three sneak-modified Symbiote extras (see the Punisher chapter).
message.projecthero.hulk.acquired: Gamma radiation floods your blood. Something huge and angry is waiting inside you.
message.projecthero.hulk.acquired_hint: Getting hurt and fighting fills your Rage. At 75 press H to let the Hulk out; at 100 he comes out on his own. As the Hulk: R Power Punch, G Ground Smash, Z Thunderclap (hold Shift+Z: HULK SMASH), X Super Leap, C Charge, V Grab. Hold N to calm down.
message.projecthero.hulk.transform_force: YOU WOULDN'T LIKE HIM WHEN HE'S ANGRY -- HULK SMASH!
message.projecthero.hulk.reverted: The rage burns out. You shrink back, exhausted.
message.projecthero.hulk.fists_only: Hulk does not need tools. HULK SMASH WITH FISTS.
projecthero.guide.hulk.tier: Hero Tier -- a Primary power (you can hold two). Never at the same time as Thor.
projecthero.guide.hulk.body: The Gamma power turns you into the Hulk when you get angry enough: a huge green brute who fights with his fists, shrugs off hits and flattens everything around him.
projecthero.guide.hulk.rage.body: Your Rage bar (0-100) sits in the bottom-right HUD as "Rage 62%". Every point of damage you take is 1% rage (take 5 damage, gain 5%) -- as Banner, the damage you deal yourself builds nothing. Go 5 seconds without being hurt and Banner cools off at 2% a second. Past 75 Banner starts to give off green gamma -- more of it, with a quickening heartbeat, the closer he gets to 100 -- and the bar throbs. After the Hulk shrinks back the bar reads "Exhausted 8s" and runs down with the timer.
projecthero.guide.hulk.change.body: There are two ways the Hulk comes out. By choice: at 75 Rage press H -- a quick change (a second and a half), and he is yours to command for as long as he lasts; you never have to fight him for control. Against your will: at 100 Rage (or when the Hulk refuses to die) Banner drops to his knees clutching his head and the change takes him slowly -- about five seconds of growing while the Hulk takes him over, then he rises and roars. You can't move, fight or be hurt while it happens, and an unwilling Hulk has to be kept under control (see Keeping control). As the Hulk, every hit you take still adds 1% per point of damage and every hit you land adds 2% (punches, and each thing your abilities hit). Only once you have been out of combat for 5 seconds does his rage burn down, 0.75% a second. At 0 you shrink back to Banner, exhausted: Weakness and Slowness for 8 seconds, and no Rage builds until it passes.
projecthero.guide.hulk.stats.body: 1.8x size (grown over a second and a half), +50% speed, punches land 20 with extra knockback, +40 max health (your health percentage carries over, plus a 20 HP burst when he comes out), diamond-level armour of his own (20 armour, 8 toughness), 90% knockback resistance, regeneration (0.75 HP every quarter second), a longer reach and a one-block step. Fire, arrows and falls don't hurt him; lava does a quarter and explosions half. His hands dig like stone tools.
projecthero.guide.hulk.fists.body: The Hulk cannot use tools, weapons, bows, crossbows, tridents or guns -- he fights with his fists, and his bare hands mine like stone tools (so iron ore still drops). Any armour you are wearing when he comes out bursts off (50 durability lost, dropped on the ground), and armour won't stay on him while he is out.
projecthero.guide.hulk.controls.body: H: let the Hulk out (Shift+H still opens the power wheel).
projecthero.guide.hulk.commands.body: /projecthero power grant hulk [player] (op). Testing helpers, op level 2: /hulk grant|revoke [players], /hulk setrage <0-100> [players]. Numbers for the abilities and the block-breaking rules are in config/projecthero_hulk.json.

projecthero.hulk.ability.transform.desc: At 75+ rage: the willing change -- quick, and you stay in control the whole time. At 100 he comes out on his own: the slow, unwilling change on your knees, and then you have to keep control. Rage burns down 1 a second; every hit he takes pours some back.
projecthero.hulk.ability.thunderclap.des: A clap that sends a shockwave rolling forward: up to 22 damage and a heavy shove to everything in a 25-block cone, and glass, ice, leaves and plants in its path shatter. 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.ground_smash.de: Both fists into the ground: 30 damage to everything within 7 blocks, thrown away and up, and a crater blown out of the ground in front of him. 5 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.super_leap.desc: Hold X to crouch and charge (1.5 s for full power), release to launch 15 to 70 blocks along your look. The landing is a shockwave (8 damage, 4.5 blocks). 2 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.hulk.origin.body: Find a Gamma Lab -- a rare ruin in the overworld where a gamma experiment went wrong -- and drink the Gamma Serum from its chest (every Gamma Lab has one). Like every hero power it replaces your oldest Primary power; it also takes Thor away, and becoming Thor takes it away. The lab's glowing Gamma Reactor feeds a Gamma player's rage (3 a second) while he stands within 4 blocks of it.
projecthero.guide.hulk.abilities.body: Only the Hulk in control can use them -- not Banner, not during a rampage.
projecthero.guide.hulk.looks.body: While he is out you are drawn as the Hulk model, 1.8 times your size, with his own idle, walk, run, clap, smash, leap and transformation animations. The change is seamless: the Hulk phases onto you as you grow and back off you as you shrink. The unwilling change has its own animation -- on your knees, shaking, then up into a roar. Your armour, cape and held items are hidden, and your first-person arm is green. Changing roars and shakes the ground.
projecthero.guide.hulk.limits.body: The Hulk cannot lift Mjolnir. He can't come out inside a Titan or while All Might's Power Form is on (and neither can be used while he is out). Respawning starts a calm Banner; logging out ends the Hulk but keeps your rage.
projecthero.guide.structure.gamma_lab.de: A rare overworld ruin of blown-out concrete and green glass with a still-glowing Gamma Reactor at its centre. Its chest always holds a Gamma Serum -- the only way to get the Hulk's power.

projecthero.hulk.ability.power_punch.des: A huge wound-up punch that hits everything in a 3-block-wide lane 6 blocks long for 30 damage and hurls it away. 5 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.hulk_smash.desc: Hold Shift+Z for 5 seconds while the gamma boils off him (let go early and it fizzles, no cooldown). Then he roars and brings everything down: 100 damage to everything 25 blocks ahead and in a 30-block shockwave all round, and a great crater. 60 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.charge.desc: He puts his head down and runs for 8 seconds straight -- steer by looking. Everything he runs through takes 20 and is knocked aside, and soft blocks in his way are smashed. 12 s cooldown once the run ends.
projecthero.hulk.ability.grab.desc: V picks up the mob you are looking at (6 blocks) and holds it overhead; V again throws it -- it smashes into whatever it hits (16 to it and everything round it). Shift+V while holding one crushes it for 26. Squad-mates can be picked up too: carried safely overhead, set down with Shift+V (or they sneak to get down), or thrown -- they bowl over enemies and land without fall damage. Bosses and anything too big can't be picked up. 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.earth_chunk.des: Shift+V with empty hands tears a chunk of earth out of the ground in front of him; V throws it and it explodes where it lands (30 damage in 4 blocks, a small crater).
projecthero.hulk.ability.calm.desc: Hold N for 2 seconds after 3 seconds out of combat: a breathing exercise opens. Hold Space as the guide ring swells and let go as it shrinks. In rhythm, the rage drains fast; out of rhythm, he gets angrier. Getting hurt breaks it. Calming the Hulk to 0 changes him back with no exhaustion.
projecthero.guide.hulk.death_save.body: Banner cannot be killed: every hit that would kill a Gamma player as Banner brings the Hulk bursting out instead, at full health with a full rage bar -- no cooldown, every time. It counts as the unwilling change, so you will have to keep him under control. To kill a Gamma player you have to beat the Hulk: a Hulk who takes a killing blow dies. The small dot beside the rage bar is bright while you are protected (Banner) and dark as the Hulk. /kill and the void still kill, and so does dying inside a Titan or in All Might's Power Form (the Hulk can't come out there).
projecthero.guide.hulk.sprint_smash.body: Sprinting as the Hulk into soft blocks (dirt, wood, stone, ores -- anything up to hardness 3, and cobwebs) smashes straight through them. Webs never slow the Hulk down, and sprinting tears them apart. Never chests or other block entities. The server can turn it off in config/projecthero_hulk.json.
projecthero.guide.hulk.control.body: Only a Hulk who came out on his own (Rage hit 100, or he refused to die) fights you for control -- one you let out with H never does. You control him as long as he keeps hitting things. Go 8 seconds without landing a hit and control starts to slip: a key prompt appears (forward, left, back or right) -- press it in time to claw control back; the wrong key or none loses more. At 0 control the Hulk RAMPAGES on his own for 15 seconds: he hunts down the nearest living thing out in the open up to 100 blocks away (never anything down in caves), leaps to it, pounds it, and smashes the ground and anything soft in his way, and your abilities are locked out. Then you wrestle back control. Anyone riding him is thrown off.
projecthero.guide.hulk.riding.body: A squad-mate can right-click the Hulk to climb onto his back -- one at a time. Sneak to hop off. The rider is thrown off when he changes back or starts to rampage. The Hulk can also pick a squad-mate up with V (see Grab).

projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.body: An endgame co-op raid for up to 8 heroes. Parademon waves, four Mother Boxes powering Darkseid’s shield, then three phases against the Lord of Apokolips himself. It never happens on its own -- you start it.
projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.start.bo: Craft a Boom Tube Beacon (Nether Star, 4 Supervillain Tokens, 2 Echo Shards, 3 Crying Obsidian -- or a Nether Star with 4 Omega Shards and 4 Crying Obsidian) and use it. Every survival player within 48 blocks joins the roster (max 8). Others can join while Darkseid is above half health; after that the roster is sealed. The arena is 64 blocks across the beacon -- stray outside and you are warned, then pulled back after a few seconds. Flight is never disabled.
projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.waves.bo: Five waves pour through Boom Tubes: Parademons; then Parademons with Ranged gunners (they strafe and circle you while they shoot, hover level with flyers and lead their shots); then Elites, Brutes and gunners in growing numbers for the last three. Parademons spread their wings and take to the air after flying heroes.
projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.mother_b: Darkseid arrives shielded; four Mother Boxes around the arena each power 25% of the shield and he takes no damage until all four are down. Right-click a box and stay within 4 blocks for 10 seconds to disrupt it (hits do not interrupt you -- walking away, or his Grip, does). A box left alone for 90 seconds OVERLOADS: Darkseid heals, the box explodes, Parademons pour out and the ground burns. Even after the shield falls he calls them back: a minute or so after all four are dark, one or two power up again (you get a few seconds of warning) -- each takes 25% off the damage he takes until you disable it again.
projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.phase1.b: Fists and a two-handed hammer up close; the Godly Ground Slam (the ring drawn on the ground is its reach -- it also hits flyers up to 10 blocks); OMEGA BEAMS, his favourite (you glow and get a warning -- two beams snake toward you in sharp zig-zags, then home in; blocks stop them and sharp turns make them overshoot); the Omega Barrage (warning circles where you are and where you are running -- leave them); DARKSEID’S GRIP (a purple line -- break line of sight before it closes; hitting him hard frees a gripped ally); the Omega Teleport (stay far away and he comes to you, even in the air); the Apokoliptian Charge (the lane is drawn on the ground -- step out of it); and Boom Tube reinforcements.
projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.phase2.b: Faster, stronger, shorter cooldowns, more reinforcements, and the OMEGA BEAM SWEEP: a knee-high beam that turns a full circle around him. Jump it, fly over it, or put a block between you and him.
projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.phase3.b: The arena burns and he is at his most dangerous (two sweep beams at once). About every 45 seconds he charges OMEGA ANNIHILATION on one hero for 5 seconds: the whole team must hit him hard (the boss bar shows how close you are) to interrupt it and stagger him for a big damage window. Fail and an arena-wide Omega blast hits everyone -- cover halves it, and it is worst for the marked hero.
projecthero.guide.darkseid_raid.death.bo: Dying does not end the raid: respawn and return after 25 seconds. The raid is lost only if every participant is down at the same time. After 15 minutes of fighting him he soft-enrages -- stronger every few minutes, more Parademons, and Mother Boxes switching back on (each takes 25% off the damage he takes until you disable it again).
Every official participant gets Darkseid’s Omega Core, likely 1-3 Omega Shards, a rare Mother Box (a personal Boom Tube home) and a very rare Omega Relic (24 charges of homing Omega Beams), plus a lot of experience. Advancements: Anti-Life, and Apokolips Falls for a raid with no overloads. Nobody gets Darkseid’s powers.
projecthero.guide.mutation.random_serums: Random-power serums (v0.13.18): the Mutagenic Serum grants a random Experimental power, the Heroic Serum a random Hero-Tier power, and the Prismatic Serum any power at all -- always one you do not have yet. Like stacking a power: a mutation needs a free slot, a hero power takes a Primary slot. If nothing new can be granted, the serum is not used up.

projecthero.guide.moon_knight.tier: Primary Power -- the Fist of Khonshu
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.body: Marc Spector died on an altar under the moon and came back as Khonshu's avenger. Moon Knight is a street-level hero who grows with the moon: strongest on a full moon night, weakest by day or underground, and fuelled by Vengeance for the ones who hunt the innocent.
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.origin.bod: Find a Temple of Khonshu in a desert (rarer than a desert pyramid). A hidden lower chamber holds the Scarab of Khonshu. At night, with the moon above the temple's open roof, right-click the altar with the Scarab, then stand on the altar and sneak -- kneel -- for 10 seconds while Khonshu speaks. Stop kneeling, step off or let the sun rise and the Scarab pops back out. Finish and you die in a flash of white... and rise again on the altar as his fist. Each altar only answers once. Sealed under a full moon, you begin with full Vengeance.
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.suit.body: Press H: for a second and a half white bandages spiral up your body (you can't be hurt while they do), then the suit of Khonshu is on, with its cape. The armour you were wearing is kept safe and handed back exactly as it was when you press H again. The suit can't be taken off, dropped or stored, and none of Moon Knight's abilities or HUD work without it. While suited, his keys win over vanilla's creative hotbar save / load (C / X).
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.lunar.body: Every ability's damage, range and duration is multiplied by the moon, and every cooldown divided by it: x1.5 at night under a full moon, x1.3 down to x1.0 as the moon wanes, x0.8 under a new moon, x0.7 by day (and in the Nether and the End). With no open sky above you it drops by another 0.15 (never below x0.6). The HUD shows tonight's moon and the live multiplier.
A 0-100 meter. Killing a hostile mob that was hunting a villager, a wandering trader, an iron golem or another player gives +5; any other hostile kill gives +2 at night and +1 by day. Go two in-game days without a hostile kill and it slowly drains. Some abilities cost Vengeance. If it runs dry while you are suited your mind Fractures: another alter takes over for 20 seconds (it can only happen once every ten minutes).
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.alters.bod: Marc Spector, the fighter: +4 armour, +20% melee damage, harder to knock back. Steven Grant, the thinker: 15% less melee damage taken, extra loot from mobs, better prices from villagers. Jake Lockley, the shadow: faster while sneaking, mobs notice you from half as far away, +50% damage attacking from behind.
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.resurrecti: While suited, the first fatal hit is cancelled: you rise at 6 hearts with a flash of white and a burst of crescents, untouchable for 2 seconds. It recharges only at the start of the next full moon night. The crescent on the HUD shows whether it is ready.
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.controls.b: Every key has three moves: tap it, hold it, or press it while sneaking. They only work in the suit.
projecthero.guide.moon_knight.commands.b: Operators: /moonknight grant | revoke | vengeance <0-100> | locate_temple | moon <0-7> [day|night] | suit on|off | status.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.darts.desc: Throw a spinning crescent dart (5). At night it gently homes on a nearby hostile mob, and if it misses it curves back to you like a boomerang.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.dart_fan.de: Charge for up to 1.5 s and release to throw a fan of 3 darts -- 5 under a full moon.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.moon_mark.d: A dart that sticks in its target: it glows for 10 s and takes 30% more damage from you.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.grapple.des: Fire a line up to 24 blocks into the block you are looking at and get pulled to it.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.dive_kick.d: Grapple to the mob you are looking at and crash into it feet first (8 + knockback).
projecthero.moon_knight.move.yank.desc: Pull the mob you are looking at to you and stun it for 1.5 s.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.truncheon.d: Summon or stow your truncheon. Every third hit in a quick chain is a heavy slam, and each hit at night heals you half a heart. It only exists while you are suited.
Extend the truncheon into a staff and spin, hitting everything within 3.5 blocks (6).
projecthero.moon_knight.move.slam.desc: On the ground: a shockwave that throws everything within 4 blocks into the air. In the air: dive straight down and slam where you land -- harder the further you fell, and you take no fall damage.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.glide.desc: In the air, spread the cape and glide (no elytra needed, no fall damage). Glides go further at night. Tap again, or land, to stop.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.shroud.desc: Wrap the cape around yourself while you hold: 60% less projectile damage, 25% less melee damage, but you move slowly. Up to 5 s.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.shadow_step: Dash 5 blocks backwards into a puff of shadow and vanish for 3 s.
Open a small picker and choose an alter directly; let go to confirm.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.alter_speci: Marc -- Fist of Khonshu: Strength II and knockback resistance for 10 s (15 Vengeance). Steven -- Scholar's Sight: chests, ores and spawners within 16 blocks glow through walls for 8 s. Jake -- Vanish: 8 s invisible, and everything hunting you loses track of you.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.moonbeam.de: Call a beam of moonlight down on the block you are looking at (up to 40 blocks): 10 damage in 2 blocks, double to the undead. Night only; costs 10 Vengeance.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.eye.desc: The ultimate. Only under a full moon with 100 Vengeance: hold for 2 s. Every hostile mob within 32 blocks glows and is weakened for 30 s, you gain Strength II and Speed II, and Khonshu's skull looks down from the sky. Once per night.
projecthero.moon_knight.move.judgement.d: Mark the mob you are looking at. If it dies within 10 s you get 20 Vengeance back and heal 3 hearts.
item.projecthero.scarab_of_khonshu.desc1: A golden scarab bearing a silver crescent, cold as moonlight.
item.projecthero.scarab_of_khonshu.desc2: Lay it on the Altar of Khonshu beneath the night sky, then kneel upon the altar.
item.projecthero.scarab_of_khonshu.desc3: Found only in the hidden chamber of a Temple of Khonshu.

message.projecthero.khonshu.ritual.line1: You who have fallen... do you hear me?
message.projecthero.khonshu.ritual.line2: The moon sees what others hide.
message.projecthero.khonshu.ritual.line3: I have watched you in the dark. You did not look away.
message.projecthero.khonshu.ritual.line4: Rise, and protect those who travel at night.
message.projecthero.khonshu.ritual.rise: Rise, my Moon Knight. The night is yours.

message.projecthero.khonshu.cancel.inter: The ritual was interrupted. The scarab falls from the altar.
advancement.projecthero.moon_knight.pact: Die on Khonshu's altar and rise again as the moon's avenger
projecthero.guide.structure.temple_of_kh: A rare sandstone temple found only in deserts, marked by a silver crescent over its door. Its roof is open to the moon above the Altar of Khonshu, and a hidden chamber beneath holds the Scarab of Khonshu. Lay the scarab on the altar at night and kneel to become Moon Knight.
